item.title: NY confirms 5 cases of highly pathogenic bird flu on Long Island
item.description: NEW YORK, USA – FEBRUARY 28: Dozens of dead birds are discovered on a Long Island beach with authorities suspecting avian flu as the cause in New York, United States on February 28, 2025. In Suffolk County, 20 carcasses were found on a small beach in East Patchogue, and tests are underway to confirm the presence of the virus. (Photo by Lokman Vural Elibol/Anadolu via Getty Images)
